title: Grounding Methods for Neural-Symbolic AI
abstract: arXiv:2507.08216v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A large class of Neural-Symbolic (NeSy) methods employs a machine learner to process the input entities, while relying on a reasoner based on First-Order Logic to represent and process more complex relationships among the entities. A fundamental role for these methods is played by the process of logic grounding, which determines the relevant substitutions for the logic rules using a (sub)set of entities. Some NeSy methods use an exhaustive derivation of all possible substitutions, preserving the full expressive power of the logic knowledge. This leads to a combinatorial explosion in the number of ground formulas to consider and, therefore, strongly limits their scalability. Other methods rely on heuristic-based selective derivations, which are generally more computationally efficient, but lack a justification and provide no guarantees of preserving the information provided to and returned by the reasoner. translated_title: 神经符号人工智能的接地方法
translated_abstract: 一大类神经符号方法使用机器学习器来处理输入实体，同时依赖基于一阶逻辑的推理器来表示和处理实体之间更复杂的关系。逻辑接地过程在这些方法中起着根本性的作用，它利用实体的（子）集来确定逻辑规则的相关替换。一些NeSy方法对所有可能的替换进行穷举推导，从而保留了逻辑知识的完整表达能力，但这会导致待考虑的基例公式数量出现组合爆炸，进而严重限制了其可扩展性。另一些方法则依赖基于启发式的选择性推导，这类方法通常在计算上更高效，但缺乏理论依据，并且无法保证保留提供给推理器以及由推理器返回的信息。（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文聚焦神经符号人工智能中的逻辑接地问题，指出穷举接地虽能完整保留逻辑表达能力但会引发组合爆炸、启发式选择性接地虽高效却缺乏正确性保证，为理解和设计兼顾效率与信息保真性的接地方法提供了系统性分析。
en_tdlr: This paper analyzes grounding methods in neural-symbolic AI, highlighting the trade-off between exhaustive grounding, which preserves full logical expressiveness but suffers from combinatorial explosion, and heuristic selective grounding, which is computationally efficient but lacks justification and guarantees of information preservation.
